sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# First retract trail fully
result = action(['LEFT', 'LEFT', 'LEFT', 'LEFT'])
print(f"After 4 LEFTs: board_changed={result.get('board_changed')}")

# Check trail length
ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
row32 = ascii_lines[32]
trail_len = 0
for i, c in enumerate(row32[16:], 16):
    if c in ('w', 'g'):
        trail_len = i - 16 + 1
    elif trail_len > 0:
        break
print(f"Trail length: {trail_len}")

# Now move UP to align with red block (row~20)
# Player currently at row~32, red block at row~20
# Each UP moves player up by ~6 rows (from 38 to 32)
# Need to go from 32 to 20, that's 12 rows up = 2 UPs
result = action(['UP', 'UP'])
print(f"\nAfter 2 UPs:")

# Find player position
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'M' and n['pixels'] == 18:
        center_r = sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
        print(f"Player at row~{center_r:.0f}")

# Check red block position
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'R' and n['pixels'] == 16 and sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary']) < 50:
        center_r = sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
        print(f"Red block at row~{center_r:.0f}")

# Check alignment
print(f"\nPlayer row area:")
for i in range(18, 24):
    print(f"Row {i}: {ascii_lines[i][10:50]}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
